projects.name: Lakbay
projects.subtitle: Airline Reservation System
projects.tagline: A web-based airline reservation system covering flight management, passenger booking, seat selection, and reservation management.
projects.summary: Lakbay handles the full booking flow of an airline — from searching flights to picking a seat and managing the reservation afterward.
description: Lakbay is a web-based airline reservation system built as an academic project. It covers the booking flow end to end: browsing available flights, booking for a passenger, choosing a seat, and reviewing or updating reservations.
The system also includes a management side for flight data, so schedules and seat availability can be kept in sync with what customers see when they book.

projects.name: BookMark
projects.subtitle: Online Bookstore
projects.tagline: An online bookstore with user accounts, a browsable catalog, a shopping cart, and order processing.
projects.summary: BookMark is a bookstore where users can create an account, browse the catalog, add books to a cart, and check out.
description: BookMark is an online bookstore application built as an academic project. Customers create an account, browse a catalog of books, add items to a shopping cart, and complete an order.
On the admin side, the catalog and inventory are managed so that stock levels and listings stay accurate as orders come in.

projects.name: PayCore
projects.subtitle: Automated Payroll System
projects.tagline: A payroll workspace for Philippine teams — attendance, deductions, and payslips in one calm place.
projects.summary: PayCore is a payroll workspace for Philippine teams, covering attendance, deductions, and payslips with separate views for owners, administrators, and employees.
description: PayCore keeps the whole pay run in one place: attendance, deductions, and payslips, with each person signing in to the view that belongs to them. Owners and administrators handle the records; employees see their own payslips.

New accounts and password resets are verified with six-digit email codes, and every pay run is built to stay auditable when someone asks questions later. A sample workspace lets visitors explore the workflow without creating an account.
features: Role-based sign in for owners, admins, and employees
Six-digit email verification for new accounts and resets
